apps.title: Gmail

credentials.how: Create an OAuth client in Google Cloud Console, enable the Gmail API, and mint an access token for gmail.readonly. Refresh the token outside the agent.

experts.title: Mail research
experts.job: Answers any question about one mailbox — what happened, who is waiting on what, what is still open — and backs every claim with the message ids it read.

apps.gate: gmail.readonly is a restricted scope. For external users Google requires app verification plus a CASA security assessment, and an OAuth client left in Testing expires refresh tokens after 7 days.
apps.dataRetention: Message bodies go to the model provider on every run. Do not persist them beyond the thread; keep the answer and the evidence ids, not the mail.

apps.title: Snapchat Ads

credentials.how: Register an app in the Snap Developer Portal, add the Marketing API, complete OAuth for the advertiser, and pass the resulting access token. Snap reviews app access before it works in production.

experts.title: Campaign report
experts.job: Reads delivery and spend across campaigns and ranks the one change most likely to help.

experts.title: Story ad launch
experts.job: Publishes a story ad end to end and reports its id, status and first-day delivery.

apps.gate: Read-only is self-service: Snap's Ads MCP needs an org admin to approve the agent and nothing else. Publishing an ad needs your own Snap app registration, Marketing API review, and a client id registered per agent.
apps.dataRetention: Snap Developer Terms limit how long data returned through Snap APIs may be retained. Check the current terms before caching stats.
